name: ControlSpace
tagline: A PLC engineering workspace with a virtual controller, in your browser
summary: ControlSpace is an independent automation-engineering workspace that implements a TIA Portal-style workflow in C#, .NET 10 and Uno Platform with shared Skia rendering. Edit PLC tag tables, ladder logic, an SCL subset, hardware topology and HMI screens, then compile and run them on a deterministic virtual PLC. The engineering model, compiler, simulator, persistence, rendering, controls and workbench ship as eight reusable libraries.
inspiredBy: Siemens TIA Portal-style PLC engineering suites

highlights.title: TIA Portal-style project view
highlights.text: Compact menus and toolbars, a project tree, central editors, task cards, a Properties/Info/Diagnostics inspector and an open-editor bar.

highlights.title: Ladder logic editor
highlights.text: Series contacts and parallel paths, NO/NC and edge contacts, comparisons, set/reset coils, TON/TOF/TP timers, CTU counters and MOVE.

highlights.title: Typed SCL subset
highlights.text: A bounded parser for assignments, IF/THEN/ELSE, arithmetic, comparisons and Boolean logic. Unsupported syntax is rejected, never evaluated.

highlights.title: Deterministic virtual PLC
highlights.text: Run, stop, reset and single-scan with input images, virtual forcing, scan-order execution, rollback on faults and a bounded trace.

highlights.title: Editable tag tables
highlights.text: A virtualized grid with inline editing, rectangular clipboard paste, validation, undo/redo, filtering, sorting and reference-safe renaming.

highlights.title: HMI screens
highlights.text: Labels, lamps, buttons, numeric displays, tanks and gauges bound to tags, with per-screen navigation and virtual-input buttons.

highlights.title: Shared Skia rendering
highlights.text: Editors draw into the host canvas via SKCanvasElement, cull offscreen ladder networks and return hit regions for interaction.

highlights.title: Simulation only, by design
highlights.text: No controller transport or hardware communication. Every execution runs in-process against a virtual controller.

shortcuts.keys: Ctrl Alt Right / Ctrl Alt Left

playground.intro: Open the compiled Uno WebAssembly build and program, compile and simulate PLC logic entirely in your browser.

tour.title: Start in Portal view
tour.text: Browse tasks grouped by Start, Devices & networks, PLC programming, Visualization and Online & diagnostics, then return to Project view.

tour.title: Explore the project tree
tour.text: Use Ctrl+Shift+F to search the project and open program blocks, tag tables, the device network and HMI screens as editor tabs.

tour.title: Edit the tag table
tour.text: Select a cell and press F2 to edit, sort or filter columns, and paste a rectangular block from a spreadsheet.

tour.title: Compile and run
tour.text: Press F7 to compile, F5 to start the virtual PLC, and click a diagnostic in the Info tab to jump to its source.

tour.title: Drive the simulation
tour.text: Use the virtual inputs task card or HMI runtime buttons, and watch monitor values and the Diagnostics inspector update. Press Esc to stop.

tour.title: Rearrange the workbench
tour.text: Drag or keyboard-resize pane dividers, collapse panes, and use Window > Reset window layout to restore defaults.

architecture.name: Model
architecture.text: Typed project records with validation and detached snapshots.

architecture.name: Compiler and runtime
architecture.text: SCL parser and LAD compiler feed a deterministic, fault-rollback virtual scan engine.

architecture.name: Persistence and editing
architecture.text: JSON/CSV storage plus validated transactions, symbol renaming, layout and editor-session state.

architecture.name: Rendering and controls
architecture.text: Shared Skia drawing with hit regions, wrapped in public Uno canvas, table, tree and pane controls.

architecture.name: Workbench
architecture.text: Composable engineering shell with host-supplied project-file and preference adapters.

boundaries: Simulation only: never use it to operate or commission real machinery
0.1.0 preview, not a feature-complete or pixel-exact replacement for Siemens TIA Portal
No FBD/STL/GRAPH, full SCL, arrays/UDTs or native Siemens project files
No S7/PROFINET/OPC UA communication, WinCC compatibility, safety, drives or motion
Floating/split editor windows and drag-and-drop tab docking are not implemented
